title: Base restores only four keys; Bench's RELAY_CLAUDE_BIN…
what: tests/relay_testbase.py:14: LOW: F1 Base restores only four keys; Bench's RELAY_CLAUDE_BIN still leaks a deleted fake binary to every later test
why: 25 Oct, review of wt/rules-red (LOW, merged as is): the test base restores four listed environment variables by hand; Bench's RELAY_CLAUDE_BIN still leaks a deleted fake binary to every later test, the same kind of shared state that made the rules-only gate red. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: In one unittest process run tests.test_bench.Bench then any later class that reaches relay_bench.claude_command or
relay_setup's install runner without setting RELAY_CLAUDE_BIN: the env still holds <tmp>/relay-test-*/.../claude from
Bench.fake_claude (test_bench.py:28), whose folder Base.tearDown deleted, so the later test gets FileNotFoundError (order
dependent, the same shape as Q1). No such test is on RULE_TESTS today, so nothing is red now.
pass_cases: 1. After a Bench test finishes, os.environ.get("RELAY_CLAUDE_BIN") equals its value before setUp (None in a clean env).
2. The bin/ci rules_tests command still runs 128 tests, OK.
3. tests.test_rules_gate_isolation still passes, and still fails with master's relay_testbase.
